claims.summary: The unit test loops over three crash endings with the checkpoint-plus-spawn Outcome: PaneGone with the Outcome removed, Exited with status 'finished', and Outcome with status 'finished'. It asserts no Pending spawn, no SpawnPending event and the Ticket still InProgress, and it passes. Red check in the base worktree: base code without the fix plus HEAD's test fails at the first kinds assertion (left [Exited, Checkpoint], right [SpawnPending, Exited, Checkpoint]). Mutation check: removing the crash_reason.is_none() guard is not caught. Reading the code shows that guard is redundant, because a valid read always yields Observed::Outcome with crash_reason None. So crash endings are protected by read.is_ok(), which the test does cover.
steps: Read the test in crates/engine/src/keep_talking.rs (HEAD lines ~1388-1474)
Base worktree: git apply HEAD's keep_talking.rs diff, re-add the Done guard, cargo test -p ac-engine --lib keep_talking (red)
Remove the Done guard (equals HEAD logic): green
Also remove decision.crash_reason.is_none(): still green (guard redundant)
